defective_pattern: Using exaggerated, emotional, or hyperbolic Persian vocabulary (e.g., 'اکیداً', 'بهطور چشمگیری', 'حیاتی') and omitting blank lines or explicit w:spacing before headings in Markdown and DOCX.
why_defective: Violates the strict objective, dispassionate academic register and results in jammed, unreadable document formatting where headings touch preceding paragraphs.
observed_symptoms: Presence of dramatic/emotional hyperbole tokens like 'مداخلات بنیادین', 'مدیران موظف‌اند', 'مسئولیت‌های خطیر', 'امری حیاتی است', 'کاتالیزور مستقیم'.
Headings missing a preceding blank line in Markdown drafts.
Headings in OpenXML docx missing <w:spacing w:before='240'/> or empty paragraph nodes.
corrective_remedy: 1) Purge emotional/hyperbolic vocabulary and enforce sober academic tone. 2) Ensure a mandatory blank line precedes every heading in Markdown. 3) Explicitly insert <w:spacing w:before='240' w:after='120'/> in DOCX XML heading paragraph properties.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Regex matching hyperbolic Persian tokens or checking for consecutive text without blank lines before markdown headers or missing w:spacing tags in Word XML.
